facts.fact: The Ministry of Health's BSD reports for Q1 2026 that the SNIS reached 100% national completeness and 99% promptness, stating that all regions and all levels of the health pyramid transmitted their data on time (seven of eight regions at 100% completeness, Faranah 98%); it adds that in Conakry more than 60% of deliveries are thought to take place in private facilities not integrated into DHIS2.

The SNIS and DHIS2 Guinée are run and reported on by the Ministry of Health and Public Hygiene's Bureau de Stratégie et de Développement, which publishes the quarterly SNIS bulletin and this performance bulletin (Q1 2026).

The bulletin places the SNIS under strategic orientation 3 of the PNDS 2025-2034 and reports that the national M&E plan of the PNDS, drafted and submitted for interministerial validation in Q1 2026, is to be integrated into DHIS2.

The bulletin's map of active partner support in Q1 2026 lists GFF/R4D against DHIS2 and the RDQA (harmonisation of DHIS2 indicator dictionaries is marked GFF) and the World Bank and Expertise France against the RDQA; it names no domestic budget line for the SNIS.

In Q1 2026 the SNIS recorded what the ministry calls a historic record of 100% completeness with an RDQA data-quality score of 82% (above the 80% threshold), WASH indicators were integrated into DHIS2, indicator dictionaries were harmonised and prefectural DHIS2 dashboards were in development.
